title: Cosmos Policy closed-loop results and Fast-WAM soft-bin / relational KL

protocol.cohort: 280 paired variants per arm: 4 suites x 7 perturbation dimensions x 10 variants; state 0; environment and sampler seeds paired
protocol.calibration: C8, two snapshots per original suite; IDs 2000, 2019, 2021, 2025, 2051, 2057, 2066, 2070; test variants excluded from fitting
protocol.inference: 5 denoising steps; 16-action chunk, 16 actions executed per replan; 30 settling steps; 400-step standard and 700-step LIBERO-10 caps
protocol.target: Same 280 DiT attention/MLP Linear modules, 1,761,607,680 target weights
protocol.execution: Decoded-BF16 weights + dynamic per-token signed fake-A4 (qmax 7); BF16 KV; no native INT4 kernel

cosmos_closed_loop.slide_ready_sentence: On the frozen 280-variant paired LIBERO-Plus cohort, action+latent-aware microscaling VQ achieved 226/280 successes (80.71%), versus 221/280 (78.93%) for adapted SpinQuant W4A4 and 233/280 (83.21%) for BF16. VQ used 4.28698 effective bpw on target weights (5.45328 across the whole DiT).
limits: Cohort differences are descriptive, not a statistical-significance or overall-superiority claim.
This comparison does not isolate action-loss versus latent-loss causality.
Effective bpw includes encoding overhead; it is not native-kernel memory or speed evidence.

shared_setup.evaluation: Decoded-BF16 VQ weights, dynamic signed A4 activations, BF16 KV, Smooth0.5/H128.
shared_setup.trainables: 614 FP32 activation clipping ratios and 1,806,863 FP32 per-input-channel log2 scales.
shared_setup.frozen: VQ codebooks, indices, row gains, B32 exponents, biases, non-target weights, and BF16 KV.
shared_setup.initialization: Soft-bin and relational final80 checkpoints independently start from original C8 rho=1.5 baseline; relational is not fine-tuned from soft-bin.
shared_setup.training: Adam, 80 updates / one epoch, fresh optimizer per arm, state reset after update 1, gradient norm clip 1.0, fixed final80, no held-out checkpoint selection.
shared_setup.plus_evaluation: Reuses saved final80 checkpoints; zero new training updates.

soft_bin.normalization: z=(x-mu_c)/max(s_c,0.02), using frozen per-action-coordinate / per-latent-channel population mean and std from original C80 teacher outputs only.
soft_bin.bins: 16 bins: 15 equally spaced interior edges from -3.5 to 3.5, plus two tails.
soft_bin.smoothing: Gaussian sigma=0.375; interior-bin mass is a Gaussian CDF difference; tails use CDF tails.
soft_bin.divergence: Mean, across paired scalar positions, of 16-bin KL(p_teacher || p_student); no temporal or spatial histogram pooling.
soft_bin.action_path: First 10 action steps x first 6 motor dimensions; excludes gripper and late 22 steps.
soft_bin.latent_path: Future latent values with frame 0 excluded; all 48 channels and spatial positions.
soft_bin.teacher: Teacher action/future tensors and teacher probabilities are detached.

relational_kl.action_tokens: Standardized first-10 x 6 motor values; ordered sliding windows length 3, stride 1 -> 8 tokens x 18 values.
relational_kl.action_neighbors: All distinct pairs among the 8 action-window tokens; self-pairs masked.
relational_kl.latent_tokens: Drop frame 0; standardize 48 channels; split width into two cameras; 2x2 average-pool with stride 2 -> 196 tokens x 48 values (2 future frames x 2 cameras x 7 x 7).
relational_kl.latent_neighbors: Eight-connected spatial neighbors in same time/camera, plus same location across distinct future times in same camera; camera views never connect.
relational_kl.distribution: d_ij=mean_k((z_i-z_j)^2); q(j|i)=softmax_j(-d_ij/T) over the fixed neighbor mask; average row-wise KL(p_teacher(j|i) || p_student(j|i)).
relational_kl.gram_matrix_note: Implementation forms pairwise mean-squared Euclidean distance matrices; it does not construct or match feature Gram matrices.

temperatures.rule: Median positive teacher neighbor distance over full C80, frozen before training

betas.rule: Separately beta=0.25 x mean teacher standardized Gaussian-noise soft-bin KL / mean relational KL; noise std=0.1 on C80 teacher only

relational_kl.teacher: Teacher tokens, distances, and probabilities are detached / computed under no_grad; gradients flow through student relations.

objectives.alpha_rule: alpha_a=mean_C80 initial action MSE / mean_C80 action soft-bin KL; alpha_z=mean_C80 initial latent NMSE / mean_C80 latent soft-bin KL; preserve original rho*c latent weighting.

fixed_input_evidence.scope: Decoded-BF16 fixed-input endpoints on original held-out 40 cases x 2 seeds; average seeds within case and weight four suites equally; no environment actions executed.
fixed_input_evidence.interpretation: Relational final80 lowered held-out first10 motor RMSE and both relational KLs versus soft-bin final80, while future-latent NMSE and pointwise latent soft-bin KL were higher. These proxies do not determine closed-loop success.

softbin_relational_plus.slide_ready_sentence: The paired LIBERO-Plus evaluation of the soft-bin and soft-bin-plus-relational checkpoints is still in progress; the latest local snapshot has 431/560 episodes complete, so final success rates are not yet available.

not_established: No final closed-loop success-rate comparison for soft-bin versus soft-bin-plus-relational is available in current local evidence.
Lower fixed-input MSE/RMSE or KL does not guarantee higher closed-loop success.
The Cosmos result evaluates the action+latent VQ recipe as a whole and does not establish native low-bit kernel speed.
